description: A kept answer's age, as the apps show it with no signal ("Fetched 42 min ago"), and whether it is past the freshness ready_to_fly holds it to: the briefing, the plan's nav log, the Go / No-Go and the weather loop for an hour (the app's choice, at AIM 7-1-28's hourly METAR), METARs and TAFs for the routine report's hour (AIM 7-1-28), the NOTAMs for an hour (14 CFR 91.103, AIM 5-1-3; the age the app's choice), and the airport cards and plates for the AIRAC cycle they came in (FAA 28 and 56 Day Product Schedule). A caution at worst: the answer is still shown.

now.description: Unix seconds, UTC: the engine has no clock.

fetched_at.description: When the network gave the kept answer, Unix seconds.

finding.description: Caution once past its freshness: the line drawn in the caution colour.

fresh_min.description: How long it is fresh, minutes; null for the kinds kept for their AIRAC cycle.
